source: Four catalog photos supplied by the owner in the Claude session on 2026-10-22 (square screenshots, about 622 x 625), with the instruction to remove the cap photo showing the supplier's brim sticker; originals preserved unchanged in designs/60_stacked-stadium-cap-dark-green-photos-2026-10-22/as-received/.
export: WebP quality 92, native scale. The light screenshot edge lines were trimmed and the backdrop extended to the 2:3 model-photo frame (designs/00_asset-library/MODEL-PHOTO-FRAME-STANDARD.md) with scripts/frame-model-photo-2x3.py; no resizing, recoloring or retouching of the original pixels.
replaces: /products/goal-wordmark-cap-dark-green.webp (the only Dark Green image, which showed the supplier's sticker on the visor; sha256 786bc5b79c903adceaf8be47069e9a074ea6ba89739be710bf79c05f9b5ad908; moved to designs/60_stacked-stadium-cap-dark-green-photos-2026-10-22/retired-render/)
